recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. The authoritative ConceptMap StructureDefinition already matches FHIR-25925, and this commit removes the remaining stale current-spec ModelInfo surface; no further core source change is indicated for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-25925 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested replacing ConceptMap.group.source/sourceVersion and ConceptMap.group.target/targetVersion URI/version pairs. The accepted modification kept the source and target element names, changed them to canonical(CodeSystem), and removed sourceVersion and targetVersion because canonical references carry version information.
initial_application: Git commit 3a8665b9c2b5a4af6baca0596216e94e7c03eb37 explicitly mentioned FHIR-25925 and updated source/conceptmap/structuredefinition-ConceptMap.xml so ConceptMap.group.source and ConceptMap.group.target are canonical CodeSystem references with no separate version elements. The parallel FHIR ModelInfo Library example/content still reflected the old uri plus sourceVersion/targetVersion shape.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini marks ConceptMap active and approved. source/library/list-Library-examples.xml and source/library/library-examples-header.xml expose Library/FHIR-ModelInfo and library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml as the FHIR model information file used by the CQL-to-ELM translator, making the ModelInfo surface build-visible. The direct Zulip discussion that led to J#25925 matches the Jira resolution. FHIR-31375 was background from the same tracker-call concern about implicit CodeSystem/all-code value set URLs, but it was resolved No Change and does not change this element-shape decision.
reconciliation: Changed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml so ConceptMap.Group.source and ConceptMap.Group.target are FHIR.canonical and removed ConceptMap.Group.sourceVersion and ConceptMap.Group.targetVersion. Regenerated the embedded ModelInfo data in source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml with the same ConceptMap.Group correction while preserving other combined-branch ModelInfo changes.
